summary.note: Revenue and expenses are kept per currency and never combined across currencies. total_revenue and net are AUD (ledger currency) and include the one AUD receipt so far, the Primal Fruits referral commission. Treesmith store proceeds are USD as reported by RevenueCat and stay in total_revenue_usd only. No FX rate has been applied because inventing one would make the receipt less true, not more; reconcile against App Store Connect payment reports when available. Benedict funds ~$100 USD/month for Claude API separately. Hetzner ~$7 AUD/mo + $1.20 backups. net is NOT a P&L and its sign means nothing: total_expenses counts each recurring expense once, while the VPS and its backups have run about six months (roughly A$50 so far, not the A$8.20 counted here).
